nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the real-time WebSocket layer, re-exporting the client (OrgiiaiWSClient), the React WSProvider/hooks (useWSClient, useWSClientSafe, useWSAvailable), and all WS message/event type definitions used for streaming session activity to the UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure re-export barrel — no logic of its own; actual client/provider implementations live in sibling ./client and ./WSProvider files outside this batch.

nodes.name: keyValidation.ts
nodes.summary: Frontend service layer for provider API-key management: validates keys, checks model availability/quotas, drives OAuth login flows for Claude Code and Codex, and exposes CRUD plus health-tracking operations for stored keys via Tauri invoke calls.

nodes.name: validateKey
nodes.summary: Validates a provider API key (and optional model) against the backend, returning whether it authenticates successfully.

nodes.name: testModelAvailability
nodes.summary: Checks whether a specific model is reachable/usable for the given provider key.

nodes.name: fetchKeyQuota
nodes.summary: Fetches the current usage quota for a provider API key.

nodes.name: refreshKeyQuota
nodes.summary: Refreshes and re-persists the cached quota for a stored key by id.

nodes.name: getCursorCliModels
nodes.summary: Lists models available through the Cursor CLI for a given key.

nodes.name: getCursorNativeModels
nodes.summary: Lists models available via Cursor's native API using a session token.

nodes.name: getOAuthModelCatalog
nodes.summary: Fetches the OAuth-provider model catalog for a given agent type.

nodes.name: getClaudeCodeOAuthModels
nodes.summary: Lists models available to a Claude Code OAuth session.

nodes.name: getCodexOAuthModels
nodes.summary: Lists models available to a Codex OAuth session.

nodes.name: refreshOauthToken
nodes.summary: Refreshes an expired OAuth access token for a stored key.

nodes.name: startClaudeCodeOauthLogin
nodes.summary: Starts the Claude Code OAuth login flow.

nodes.name: exchangeClaudeCodeOauthCode
nodes.summary: Exchanges a Claude Code OAuth authorization code (with PKCE verifier/state) for access tokens.

nodes.name: startCodexOauthLogin
nodes.summary: Starts the Codex OAuth login flow.

nodes.name: exchangeCodexOauthCode
nodes.summary: Exchanges a Codex OAuth authorization code for access tokens.

nodes.name: listKeys
nodes.summary: Lists metadata for all stored provider API keys.

nodes.name: getKey
nodes.summary: Retrieves metadata for a single stored key by agent type and key id.

nodes.name: getKeyById
nodes.summary: Retrieves metadata for a single stored key by id.

nodes.name: getFullKey
nodes.summary: Retrieves the full unmasked key value for a stored credential.

nodes.name: saveKey
nodes.summary: Persists a new or updated provider API key.

nodes.name: deleteKey
nodes.summary: Deletes a stored key by agent type and key id.

nodes.name: deleteKeyById
nodes.summary: Deletes a stored key by id.

nodes.name: updateKeyHealth
nodes.summary: Updates the recorded health status, available/enabled models, quota, and context lengths for a stored key.

nodes.name: promptPolish
nodes.summary: Sends text to the prompt-polish service and returns an improved version.

nodes.name: sessionStepExplain
nodes.summary: Requests an AI-generated explanation of a session step.

nodes.name: housekeeperHealthCheck
nodes.summary: Runs a health-check request against the housekeeper backend service.

nodes.name: housekeeperTokenBenchmark
nodes.summary: Runs a token-throughput benchmark via the housekeeper service.

nodes.name: housekeeperUiIntent
nodes.summary: Sends UI context text to the housekeeper service to resolve user intent.

nodes.name: getEnvForAgent
nodes.summary: Builds the environment variables needed to run a given agent with its configured key.

nodes.name: getAllKeysForAgent
nodes.summary: Retrieves all stored keys applicable to a given agent's configured providers.

nodes.name: autoDetectKey
nodes.summary: Attempts to auto-detect an already-configured provider key on the local machine.

nodes.name: scanCliVersion
nodes.summary: Detects the installed version of a provider's CLI tool, optionally forcing a rescan.

nodes.name: microphone.ts
nodes.summary: Service wrapping OS-level microphone permission checks and settings deep-links so the renderer can detect and request microphone access across platforms.

nodes.name: getMicrophoneSettingsDeepLink
nodes.summary: Returns the OS-specific deep-link URL to open microphone privacy settings.

nodes.name: canOpenMicrophoneSystemSettings
nodes.summary: Reports whether the current platform supports opening microphone settings directly.

nodes.name: openMicrophoneSystemSettings
nodes.summary: Opens the OS microphone privacy settings page via the deep link.

nodes.name: checkMicrophonePermission
nodes.summary: Checks the current microphone permission status for the app.

nodes.name: requestMicrophonePermission
nodes.summary: Requests microphone permission from the OS, prompting the user if needed.

nodes.name: notification.ts
nodes.summary: Desktop notification and sound service: manages notification permission requests, plays completion/alert sounds, and dispatches system notifications for task completion, approvals, errors, session status changes, and git operations.

nodes.name: getAudioElement
nodes.summary: Lazily creates/caches the HTMLAudioElement used to play notification sounds.

nodes.name: playGeneratedSound
nodes.summary: Plays a generated notification chime at the given volume.

nodes.name: checkNotificationPermission
nodes.summary: Checks whether desktop notification permission is currently granted.

nodes.name: requestNotificationPermission
nodes.summary: Requests desktop notification permission from the OS.

nodes.name: sendSystemNotification
nodes.summary: Sends a native OS notification with the given title and body.

nodes.name: playCompletionSound
nodes.summary: Plays the task-completion sound effect at the given volume.

nodes.name: notify
nodes.summary: Central dispatcher that sends a notification (and optional sound) honoring the user's notification settings.

nodes.name: notifyTaskCompletion
nodes.summary: Sends a notification announcing that a task has completed.

nodes.name: notifyAgentApproval
nodes.summary: Sends a notification requesting user approval for an agent action.

nodes.name: notifyError
nodes.summary: Sends a notification surfacing an error message to the user.

nodes.name: notifySessionStatus
nodes.summary: Sends a notification reflecting a session status change.

nodes.name: notifyGitOperation
nodes.summary: Sends a notification about the outcome of a git operation.

nodes.name: sendTestNotification
nodes.summary: Sends a test notification so the user can preview their notification settings.

nodes.name: cliTerminalSession.ts
nodes.summary: Builds and launches CLI TUI (terminal UI) sessions for coding agents — formats platform-specific shell commands and creates/releases the underlying Tauri terminal session.

nodes.name: formatCliTuiCommand
nodes.summary: Formats the shell command line used to launch a CLI agent's terminal UI for a given profile.

nodes.name: resolveCliTuiCommand
nodes.summary: Resolves the platform-appropriate CLI TUI command, quoting arguments for POSIX shells as needed.

nodes.name: cliAgentCreateTuiSession
nodes.summary: Creates a new Tauri-backed terminal session running the resolved CLI TUI command.

nodes.name: cliAgentTuiRelease
nodes.summary: Releases/tears down a previously created CLI TUI terminal session.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Assembles and patches the per-agent configuration blob sent to the Rust backend, merging agent definition, integrations, policy, session-model, and tool-permission edits into the persisted config shape.

nodes.name: cloneCommandRiskRules
nodes.summary: Deep-clones a set of command risk rules so callers can mutate a copy safely.

nodes.name: getDefaultCommandRiskRules
nodes.summary: Returns the default set of command risk rules used when none are configured.

nodes.name: riskRulesForBlob
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective risk rules to embed in a config blob, falling back to defaults.

nodes.name: assembleAgentConfigBlob
nodes.summary: Assembles the full persisted agent config blob from the agent definition, integrations, kind, and risk rules.

nodes.name: getAgentConfig
nodes.summary: Fetches the persisted configuration for a given agent type/workspace.

nodes.name: updateAgentConfig
nodes.summary: Sends a partial update to persist changes to an agent's configuration.

nodes.name: extractAgentDefPatch
nodes.summary: Extracts the agent-definition portion of a patch from a raw config blob.

nodes.name: extractIntegrationsPatch
nodes.summary: Extracts the integrations portion of a patch from a raw config blob.

nodes.name: buildAgentPolicyPatch
nodes.summary: Builds the policy-section patch object from a config blob.

nodes.name: buildSessionModelPatch
nodes.summary: Builds a patch object for session-model edits.

nodes.name: buildAgentToolsPatch
nodes.summary: Builds the tools-section patch object from a config blob.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module aggregating the Agent API surface (types, tool names, session, workspace, gateway, config, tools, automation, and AgentOrg task submodules) into a single import point for agent-related Tauri IPC commands.
